parameters.content:
## CallNode AI messaging for texts and pictures

### How it works

- CallNode sends every text or picture message that reaches your number to the webhook.
- If a picture is attached, OpenAI describes it. The AI assistant then writes a short reply, with a memory of each conversation.
- The reply goes straight back to CallNode, which delivers it in the same thread.
- When someone asks for a picture, the workflow makes one with OpenAI and sends it as a picture message through the CallNode API.
- A form sends a text, with an optional picture link, from your number.

### Setup

1. Create a CallNode account at callnode.io, add funds and buy a local phone number.
2. In the webhook node, create a Header Auth credential: name X-CallNode-Secret, value a long random string. Copy the Production URL and publish the workflow.
3. In CallNode, open the number's Messaging Settings. Set Webhook URL to that URL, Authentication Type to Custom Header, and the same header name and value. They must match exactly, or texts get no reply.
4. Add your OpenAI credential to the chat model and both picture nodes. Set businessName in Settings.
5. To send pictures and form messages, create a live API key in CallNode and enter apiKey, apiSecret and fromNumber in API Settings. Then text your number.

Full guide: [callnode.io/integrations/n8n](https://callnode.io/integrations/n8n)

### Customization tips

- Replace the ABOUT YOUR BUSINESS lines in the assistant's system message with your hours, services and common questions.
- Swap the chat model for any model n8n supports.
- Replace the form with any trigger that provides a phone number and a message, such as a new order or booking.

## Receive the message

CallNode posts each incoming text or picture message to the webhook. Settings holds your business name.

## Write the reply

An attached picture is described first. The AI assistant then answers, with a memory per conversation.

## Reply to CallNode

Puts the answer in a reply field and returns it. CallNode delivers it in the same thread.

## Choose what to send

A picture request or a form submission continues here. API Settings holds your CallNode API key, secret and sending number.

## Make the picture

OpenAI generates the picture. The file is then turned into text so it can travel inside the request.

## Send the picture

Builds the request, signs it with your API secret and posts it to the CallNode messages API.

## Send a text from the form

Builds and signs the request, sends it through the CallNode API and confirms on the form.

parameters.text: Describe this picture in two or three plain sentences for a text-message assistant that will answer the sender. If the picture contains text, quote it exactly.

={{ (() => { const w = $('CallNode Webhook').item.json.body; const caption = (w.body || '').trim(); const j = $json; const c = j.content !== undefined ? j.content : (j['0'] && j['0'].content); const desc = typeof c === 'string' ? c : (Array.isArray(c) ? c.map(p => (typeof p === 'string' ? p : (p.text || ''))).join(' ') : ''); const pic = (w.media || []).length ? ' (The person attached a picture. What it shows: ' + (desc.trim() || 'it could not be read') + ')' : ''; return (caption + pic).trim() || 'The person sent an empty message.'; })() }}

options.systemMessage:
=You are the friendly text-message assistant for {{ $('Settings').item.json.businessName }}. You are replying to a text message from a customer.

HOW TO WRITE
- Reply in plain text: one to three short sentences, under 300 characters.
- No markdown, lists, emoji or links.
- If you do not know something, say so and offer what you can help with.

ABOUT YOUR BUSINESS (replace these lines with your own details)
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM.
- No other details have been added yet.

Only state facts that are listed in this section. If the person asks about anything that is not listed, such as products, services, prices or location, say you do not have that information to hand and offer to help with something else. Never guess, and never write placeholder text or anything in square brackets, except the picture marker described below.

PICTURES THEY SEND
When the message says what an attached picture shows, treat that as what the person sent you and answer about it. If it says the picture could not be read, say you could not open it and ask them to describe what they need.

PICTURES THEY ASK FOR
If the person asks you to make, draw, create or generate a picture or image, reply with one short sentence saying you are making it and it will arrive in a moment, and put [image: a clear one-sentence description of the picture to make] at the very end of your reply.

parameters.formDescription: Sends an SMS from your CallNode number. Add a picture link to send it as a picture message (MMS).

assignments.name: body
assignments.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ to: $('CallNode Webhook').item.json.body.from, from: $('CallNode Webhook').item.json.body.to, body: $json.imageBase64 ? 'Here is your picture.' : 'Sorry, I could not make that picture this time.', media: $json.imageBase64 ? ['data:' + ($json.mimeType || 'image/png') + ';base64,' + $json.imageBase64] : [] }) }}

assignments.name: body
assignments.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ to: (p => p.startsWith('+') ? p : (p.length === 10 ? '+1' + p : '+' + p))(String($('Send a Text').item.json['Phone number']).replace(/[^0-9+]/g, '')), from: $json.fromNumber, body: $('Send a Text').item.json['Message'], media: String($('Send a Text').item.json['Image link (optional)'] || '').trim() ? [String($('Send a Text').item.json['Image link (optional)']).trim()] : [] }) }}

parameters.completionMessage: ={{ 'CallNode accepted your message (ID ' + $json.id + ', status ' + $json.status + '). Delivery can still fail for a wrong or unreachable number; the Messages page in CallNode shows the final status.' }}
